# SYNESIS_E054 — Error

## Description

FORMAT declared in `field_name` (type TEXT) — FORMAT is exclusive to SCALE.

## Severity

An **error** stops compilation: no JSON, CSV or other export is written until it is fixed. Errors local to an `EXPORT` block are reported as warnings when compiling and stop only that block in `synesis export`.

## Compiler message

```text
The field 'field_name' declares `FORMAT`, but its type is `TEXT`.
  The `FORMAT [min..max]` declaration is exclusive to SCALE fields.
  This problem is in the template definition.
  Remove the `FORMAT` declaration or change the field type to `SCALE`.
```

## Where it appears

Values the diagnostic carries (what the message names):

- **FormatOnNonScale**: `field_name`, `field_type`
